rule_or_requirement: Preserve valid completion while retaining pixel-student lap gain by reducing late obstacle approaches.
observable_information: Only rendered grayscale pixels: small far bright component relative to visible road center and student posterior; completion, collisions and trace telemetry for evaluation.
allowed_action_or_state_change: After two consistent far-object detections, suppress only learned extra gas and retain inherited pixel-driver action.
expected_success_endpoint: At least 10 extra-gas suppressions, three before the reference collision, reference finish preserved, one prior failure repaired and zero invalid actions.
control: Original frozen pixel student safe checkpoint SHA-256 3c3cafc0d549c3777a6489ede397a4bd4f2390f8f2b1597ae6e0960dd4dc2194 with no far-object guard.
falsifier: No early obstacle signal, false suppressions that lose the reference finish, no repaired failure or invalid actions.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Two pixel-student arms on three consumed TUNE identities 1:5200, 3:5201, 2:5205, six episodes.
resource_and_risk_gate: One registered Linux CPU diagnostic, 900 seconds and 2,000 decisions per episode; no fresh competitive or external action.
